sources.title: Post-Stall Navigation with Fixed-Wing UAVs using Onboard Vision
sources.review_notes: All 7 pages reviewed against page renders by one reviewer agent (report: reports/review-pages-0001-0007.md): reading order of the two-column layout, headings, 10 figures and Algorithm 1 re-boxed and checked by crops, equations (1)-(5) transcribed from the authors' TeX and compared with 280-300 dpi crops, 30 reference entries compared with native PDF lines. Verifier diagnostics on pages 3 and 4 are LaTeX-notation differences and are adjudicated per page.
